title: CS50: Introduction to Computer Science
description: Broad introduction to computer science covering programming in C and Python, algorithms, memory, and data structures.

title: Python for Everybody
description: Learn Python programming from scratch, including variables, loops, functions, data structures, and working with files and web data.

title: Introduction to Computer Science and Programming Using Python
description: Computational thinking and Python programming, covering algorithms, recursion, object-oriented programming, and basic complexity analysis.

title: Nand to Tetris, Part I
description: Build a computer from logic gates up, covering Boolean logic, an ALU, machine language, and an assembler.

title: Algorithms, Part I
description: Core algorithms and data structures including union-find, sorting, priority queues, binary search trees, and hash tables.

title: Algorithms, Part II
description: Graph algorithms, shortest paths, minimum spanning trees, maximum flow, string processing, and tries.

title: Introduction to Algorithms (6.006)
description: Algorithm design and analysis covering sorting, hashing, graph search, shortest paths, and dynamic programming.

title: Data Structures and Algorithms Specialization
description: Algorithmic toolbox, data structures, graph algorithms, string algorithms, and dynamic programming with programming assignments.

title: Design and Analysis of Algorithms (6.046J)
description: Advanced algorithm design including amortized analysis, network flow, randomized algorithms, and NP-completeness.

title: HTML, CSS, and Javascript for Web Developers
description: Build web pages with HTML, CSS, and JavaScript, covering the DOM, events, and responsive layouts.

title: Front-End Web Development with React
description: Build single-page applications with React, covering components, state, routing, and forms.

title: Server-side Development with NodeJS, Express and MongoDB
description: Build backend servers with Node.js and Express, REST APIs, and MongoDB for persistent storage.

title: Full Stack Open
description: Modern full stack web development with React, Node.js, REST APIs, testing, and TypeScript.

title: CS50's Web Programming with Python and JavaScript
description: Web apps with Python, Django, JavaScript, databases, APIs, and deployment.

title: Linear Algebra (18.06)
description: Matrices, vector spaces, eigenvalues, and singular value decomposition taught by Gilbert Strang.

title: Mathematics for Machine Learning: Linear Algebra
description: Linear algebra for machine learning, covering vectors, matrices, eigenvectors, and applications to data.

title: Introduction to Probability
description: Probability theory covering conditional probability, random variables, distributions, and expectation.

title: Machine Learning Specialization
description: Supervised learning, regression, classification, neural networks, decision trees, and recommender systems.

title: Applied Machine Learning in Python
description: Practical machine learning with scikit-learn, covering model selection, evaluation, and supervised learning.

title: Practical Deep Learning for Coders
description: Top-down deep learning with PyTorch, covering image classification, NLP, and deploying models.

title: Deep Learning Specialization
description: Neural networks, optimization, convolutional networks, and sequence models such as RNNs and transformers.

title: Natural Language Processing Specialization
description: Natural language processing with classification, embeddings, attention models, and transformers.

title: CS231n: Deep Learning for Computer Vision
description: Convolutional neural networks for visual recognition, covering image classification, detection, and segmentation.

title: Introduction to Structured Query Language (SQL)
description: Learn SQL for relational databases, covering queries, joins, aggregation, and database design basics.

title: Intro to Database Systems (15-445)
description: Database internals including storage, indexing, query execution, concurrency control, and recovery.

title: The Bits and Bytes of Computer Networking
description: Fundamentals of computer networking, covering the TCP/IP model, DNS, routing, and network services.

title: Google Cybersecurity Professional Certificate
description: Entry-level cybersecurity covering threats, risk management, network security, and incident response.

title: Cryptography I
description: Cryptographic primitives including stream ciphers, block ciphers, message integrity, and public-key encryption.

title: Operating System Engineering (6.S081)
description: Operating system internals covering processes, virtual memory, file systems, and concurrency, built in C.
